title: Kerry James Marshall: The Complete Prints 1976–2022

description.main: A catalogue raisonné of Kerry James Marshall's prints from 1976 to 2022, with a study by Susan Tallman, published by Ludion and distributed in North America by D.A.P.
description.extended:
A catalogue raisonné of the prints of Kerry James Marshall, from 1976 to 2022, many of them never publicly shown.

The art historian Susan Tallman catalogues the work and writes the first extended account of the part printed images and print processes play in Marshall's practice. The prints run from postcard-sized sheets to a 50-foot woodcut in twelve panels, and include versions of his ongoing project Rythm Mastr. Most were made by Marshall alone in his studio rather than in professional print workshops. The book is a clothbound volume with about 150 colour illustrations, published in 2023 by Ludion in Belgium and D.A.P. in the United States.

Marshall is a painter whose subjects are Black figures. He has said the point is to show that blackness is rich and complex within the blackness alone. In 2020 he painted one of two covers for the September issue of Vogue.
